subject: Re: Community evening
text: Hello, I hope your week has been steady. I am following up on the note you sent two days ago, when you asked whether the gathering will remain informal. I want to share the event details plainly, so there is no confusion. We will meet in the back hall of the library, beginning at six, with a brief introduction at six-fifteen. If the weather remains mild, we may shift the main activity to the courtyard, but the room is booked either way. Parking on the side street is likely to be full, so the lot behind the school may be simpler, even if the walk is slightly longer. Please dress comfortably; there will be chairs, not a seated dinner, though there will be tea, fruit, and simple bread. You are welcome to come alone or bring someone, but if you do, please mention the extra name in advance. It helps when we arrange the tables. I realize the plan could feel a little fluid until the final day, and I appreciate your patience. If your schedule becomes uncertain, a quiet note would be enough—no need to explain at length. It would mean a lot to keep things relaxed and respectful. Otherwise, I look forward to seeing you there, and I hope the event offers a calm space for everyone who comes.
